# Solution Brief

> Produces and validates Estate Solution Briefs from an evidence-governed relational solution graph.

**What it does.** Produce and validate Estate Solution Briefs from an evidence-governed solution graph: judge whether a proposed solution is technically deliverable and make the delivery logic inspectable across systems, interfaces, failure paths, ADRs, scope, risks, assumptions, dependencies, staffing, phases, milestones, and financial reconciliation.
